reasons.view2d-guard: 03 already owns editor-scoped Shift-wheel selection. Global scroll suppression would also remove outside-editor fallback.
reasons.modal: The accepted modal capability does not cover this exact token and map.
reasons.operator-rna: The reference could not read the operator RNA. The operator or its parameters cannot be verified.
reasons.property-schema: The captured RNA uses an unreadable field or nested/collection property the runtime cannot assign or read back.
reasons.event-schema: The captured native event requires TEXTINPUT or a non-default hyper state outside the accepted item-creation schema.
reasons.provider-required: This binding requires a reference-only add-on operator, menu or tool whose installed provenance and dispatch are unverified.
reasons.inactive-target: An inactive owned row cannot disable the inherited active input. Retaining it could misrepresent the effective shortcut.
reasons.inherited-input: The input overlaps an inherited active binding in this map. No accepted precedence capability covers the exact overlap.
reasons.earlier-reference-input: Installing this row alone could promote it ahead of an earlier reference route, or the runtime cannot own both exact events.
reasons.inactive-shared-input: The runtime can reject an inactive declaration sharing the exact event of an active owned row.
reasons.duplicate-occurrences: One occurrence is represented. The runtime cannot preserve repeated identical owned requests in one map.
reasons.stock-reduction: The stock occurrence count is higher. Generic suppression would change inherited behavior outside proven contexts.
reasons.absent: The full merged reference has no occurrence. Active/preset-only or provider-only evidence does not prove a merged shortcut.
